export_evidence: ImportKey page for INDO WINGS PRIVATE LIMITED (https://importkey.com/countries/india/indo-wings-private-limited) reports 'Total Shipments 144 Records detected', 'Trading Partners 2', 'Ports 4', 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-26'. Every row actually displayed is INBOUND into India, e.g. '2026-02-26 | ARGOSDYNE CO., LTD | INDO WINGS PRIVATE LIMITED | SMART BATTERY 50S (SAMPLE FOR BIS TESTING PURPOSES) (THIS IS DRONE BATTERY) | SEOUL INCHEON INT, SOUTH KOREA | DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 88073020 | BOL 7767845' and '2025-09-15 | PARTIZAN SECURITY S R O | INDO WINGS PRIVATE LIMITED | FRAME (MARK4-10 PARTIZAN EDITION 10 | PRAGUE RUZYNE, CZECH REPUBLIC | DELHI AIR CARGO, India | 88079000 | BOL 7239451'. No outbound shipment row, no export destination outside India, and no export B/L was seen. Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 144 shipments; 5 individual rows were rendered and all 5 are imports (origin Korea/Taiwan/Czech Republic -> destination India). Slug variants tried: 'indo-wings-private-limited' (144 records, imports only), 'indo-wings-pvt-ltd' (page rendered with no records), 'indo-wings' (page rendered with no records).

note: Declared HS 880623 (drones/UAV) is consistent with the goods actually seen in customs data — drone batteries, drone receivers, drone frames and motors under HS 88073020, 88073010, 88079000 and 85014090 — so no HS correction is needed on the evidence available. IMPORTANT: the customs trail proves this company BUYS drone components from Korea (Argosdyne), Taiwan (Nurlmch, Fast Create, LCSC HK) and Czech Republic (Partizan Security), not that it ships anything out. It appears to be an importer/assembler of FPV drone kits. No export shipment with date, destination and B/L was found, and no domestic supply trace (GST turnover, GeM/CPPP tender, contract) was found either — следов поставок не найдено. Note the counterparty 'KALYAN DEF TECH LLP' appears in one supplier row alongside Indo Wings, suggesting a related entity; not investigated here. Search tooling was degraded (DuckDuckGo backend refused connections; volza, eximpedia and trademo returned HTTP 403), so absence of export records is based on ImportKey free views only and should be re-checked against a paid export dataset before final rejection of the export claim.
